method: Inclusion is every species printed under the Nycteridae heading on the 2011 Wayback SANParks KNP mammal checklist PDF (2 species). English and Afrikaans names, and species order, are taken from that PDF. Scientific names are the 2011 names unless an iNaturalist taxon record cited in remaps gives a current name. Research-grade counts are for iNaturalist place_id 69020. iNaturalist-only nycteridae are in candidates, not species. The PDF was fetched to a temporary path for text extraction and was not copied into this project.

sources.role: Official inclusion list; English and Afrikaans species names; species order; absence of asterisk status flags on Nycteridae
Research-grade species counts for Nycteridae in Kruger (place 69020); 1 species in this pull (Nycteris thebaica, 12). Nycteris woodi was absent from this pull.
All-grade Nycteridae taxonomy tree for place 69020; used to confirm Nycteris thebaica (13 observations of any grade) and the absence of Nycteris woodi
Current name lists for Nycteris thebaica and Nycteris woodi; used with taxa?id=41192,41190&all_names=true

remaps.note: iNaturalist preferred_common_name for taxon 41192. Common Slit-faced Bat remains a listed English name on the same taxon. The stored en value is the 2011 SANParks checklist name.

notes: On the official 2011 checklist, but no research-grade iNaturalist observations in place 69020. The species is also absent from the place taxonomy tree, and observation total_results for taxon 41190 is 0.

gaps: Live SANParks checklist HTML and PDF were not fetched in this session (Phase 1 recorded HTTP 403). Inclusion is the 2011 Wayback PDF only, and has not been compared with the live 147–148 figure.
iNaturalist checklist 8810 was not fetched (Phase 1 recorded HTTP 403/401).

Nycteris woodi is on the official list, but has 0 research-grade iNaturalist observations in place 69020 and is absent from the place taxonomy tree. Absence of an iNat record was not treated as absence from KNP.

No rare, reintroduced, or introduced flags are recorded for official Nycteridae species: the 2011 PDF does not mark any of them with an asterisk or other status note (asterisks on that list are only for house mouse and house/black rat under Muridae).
The current live official list, Skinner & Chimimba, and Stuart's guide were not available to corroborate remaps or flags.
